Seed 7700360 (found by scanning 7700001-7700600 for a D:1 'Buried zombies' theme room; 4 of 600 had one) puts the room two squares east of the corridor at (15,8). The hero walks there in 14 keys and waits with 's' (!safe_wait keeps waiting legal beside a hostile newt) while her kitten roams the room; its footfalls cut each nearby corpse's ZOMBIFY_MON timer to two thirds until an orc zombie claws itself out at about turn 40. The hero never stands within one square of a corpse, so hack.c:2947's hero-step disturbance plays no part.
